Federal filings: FEC totals are held for federal candidates and render on the ballot card rather than through this answer. Nothing above is drawn from them, so their absence here says nothing about what the FEC holds.

gaps.statement: We have not recorded any actions in office for Kelly Ayotte.
Arizona's legislature lists 264 bills that became law in the 57leg/2r session. We have read 29 of them so far, so anything here about bills she signed is a partial account and not the whole session.

She also sent the legislature 151 letters about individual bills. We have retrieved 1 of those letters and have not been able to read 1 of them — they are scanned images and we do not yet have text recognition for them. We hold the documents and can link you to them, but we will not say what any of them decided until we have read it.
We read 12 of the 37 executive orders we indexed, and the index continues past what we walked.
We have not recorded any sourced statement of Kelly Ayotte's positions.
We have not recorded a voting record for Kelly Ayotte. A voting record exists only for a seat we hold in one of the chambers we cover.

The campaign-finance records we hold are the county filing officer's, and they link a committee to the OFFICE it filed for. Kelly Ayotte is not on a body that register covers, so we have attached no committee here. That is the reach of what we have acquired — not a finding that no filings exist.

County filings: we hold the Pima County filing officer's own itemized contribution and distribution records, and they are what any county-level answer here is built from. We hold no other county's filings.

State filings: we hold Arizona's reporting calendar, and we have NOT acquired the state's itemized filings. So a state-level committee raising or spending money around Kelly Ayotte would not appear above — that is our gap, not a statement that none exists.

Federal filings: FEC totals are held for federal candidates and render on the ballot card rather than through this answer. Nothing above is drawn from them, so their absence here says nothing about what the FEC holds.
